summary: Toro Corp., a Cyprus-domiciled NASDAQ-listed energy transportation company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 11, 2026, at its Limassol office. Shareholders approved re-election of Chairman/CEO Petros Panagiotidis as Class C Director through the 2029 AGM and appointed Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No special-situations transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is present. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-results disclosure equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.07; no deal terms to watch.
